manifest.name: pr142-kq-imatrix-downs-gdn
manifest.description: #142's map (unsloth's routed gate/up, every routed expert down on Q4_K, the recurrent qkv of all 30 Gated DeltaNet layers and the recurrent z/out of layers 20-39 on Q4_K, the rest Q8_0: RP-KL 0.0713, decode 447.0, 23.42 GiB) with the merged kq_imatrix on the Q4_K tensors the pinned statistics cover: the 40 routed expert downs (per-expert exps_down.sumsq / count), the recurrent qkv and the deep recurrent z (GPTQ on attn_input.xtx). The formats, and so decode, prefill and memory, are #142's; only the rounding changes. The recurrent out projections, lm_head and the embeddings have no statistics and keep kq_rtn (uniform weights there moved the MMLU-Pro answer format in #146's first form); unsloth's gate/up and Q8_0 bytes are kept.
